Wide horizontal lockup, framed close with a small transparent margin, readable at 240px wide; symbol should survive 32px. Exact spelling and all words. Only one logo, never a presentation board. Proposed identity, not claimed official/adopted.

Every letter of the full name and descriptor must be solid clean WHITE, not colored or gray. Existing restrained emblem accent may remain only if visible; keep all primary ink white. Genuine alpha transparency and open counters, smooth clean edges. No background panel, no checkerboard, no new wording, design, texture, distress, shadow, watermark or decoration. One matching white/light-ink horizontal logo for dark and red headers. Exact name: AL WAJAHA AUTO FZE.
